details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: double free in the RAR4 reader with over 4 billion nodes
     - debian/patches/CVE-2025-5914.patch: widen the block cursor and node
       count to size_t and guard the previous block lookup in
       archive_read_format_rar_seek_data() in
       libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar.c, add test
     - CVE-2025-5914
   * SECURITY UPDATE: infinite loop in the RAR5 reader
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-4111.patch: reject filters whose block length
       exceeds half the window in parse_filter() in
       libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c, add test
     - CVE-2026-4111
   * SECURITY UPDATE: out-of-bounds read in the RAR4 reader after a PPMd block
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-4424.patch: reallocate an undersized LZSS
       window in parse_codes() in
       libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar.c
     - CVE-2026-4424
   * SECURITY UPDATE: undefined behaviour and heap overflow via invalid
     zisofs block size
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-4426-CVE-2026-5121.patch: check the ZF entry
       length and reject pz_log2_bs outside 15..17 in parse_rockridge_ZF1()
       in libarchive/archive_read_support_format_iso9660.c, add test
     - CVE-2026-4426
     - CVE-2026-5121
   * SECURITY UPDATE: double free in the RAR5 reader
     - debian/patches/CVE-2026-14164.patch: reset the window and filter
       buffer pointers after freeing them in init_unpack() in
       libarchive/archive_read_support_format_rar5.c
     - CVE-2026-14164
